items.title: Section: All Four Objects of Meditation Formally Summarised

items.zh: 滅有二種。一、煩惱滅，二、所依滅。道有二種。一、有學道，二、無學道。如是當知名出世道淨惑所緣。如是已說四種所緣。一、遍滿所緣，二、淨行所緣，三、善巧所緣，四、淨惑所緣。
items.en: Cessation is of two kinds: the ending of affliction, and the ending of what affliction depends on. The path is of two kinds: the path of the trainee, and the path of one beyond training. Thus should the purifying-of-affliction objects of the supramundane path be known. Thus the four objects of meditation have now been explained: pervasive objects, purifying objects, skilful objects, and purifying-of-affliction objects.

items.title: Section: Topic Three Closes; Instruction Opens as Topic Four

items.zh: 謂四教授。一、無倒教授，二、漸次教授，三、教教授，四、證教授。云何無倒教授？謂無顛倒宣說法義，令其受持、讀誦、修學，如實出離，正盡眾苦，作苦邊際。如是名為無倒教授。云何漸次教授？謂稱時機宣說法義，先令受持讀誦淺近，後方令彼學深遠處。又為令入初諦現觀，先教苦諦，後集滅道。又為令得靜慮等至，先教最初靜慮等至，後教其餘靜慮等至。如是等類，應知名為漸次教授。云何教教授？謂從尊重、若似尊重，達解瑜伽軌範、親教，或諸如來，或佛弟子所聞正教，即如其教不增不減教授於他，名教教授。云何證教授？謂如自己獨處空閑所得、所觸、所證諸法，為欲令他得、觸、證故，方便教授，名證教授。
items.en: There are four kinds of instruction: undistorted instruction, gradual instruction, teaching-instruction, and realisation-instruction. What is undistorted instruction? It is expounding the teaching and its meaning without any distortion, so that the student retains it, recites it, and trains in it — thereby genuinely gaining release, fully ending all suffering, and reaching suffering's utter limit. What is gradual instruction? It is expounding the teaching in a manner suited to the occasion and the student's readiness — first having them retain and recite what is simple and near at hand, only later leading them to what is deep and far-reaching; teaching the truth of suffering first, before the truths of origin, cessation, and the path, so as to bring them into direct insight; and teaching the first absorption first, before the remaining stages of concentration. What is teaching-instruction? It is instruction received from a respected teacher, or one comparable in standing, a preceptor or mentor versed in the yogic disciplines — or ultimately from the Tathāgatas or the Buddha's disciples — and transmitted onward to others exactly as received, neither adding to it nor subtracting from it. What is realisation-instruction? It is instructing others, through skilful means, so that they too may attain, touch, and realise the very things one has personally attained, touched, and realised in solitary retreat.

items.title: Section: The Three Miraculous Powers Complete Instruction — Fascicle 27 Complete

items.zh: 復有諸相圓滿教授。其事云何？謂由三種神變教授。三神變者，一、神境神變，二、記說神變，三、教誡神變。由神境神變，能現種種神通境界，令他於己生極尊重；由彼於己生尊重故，於屬耳聽瑜伽作意，極生恭敬。由記說神變，能尋求他心行差別。由教誡神變，如根、如行、如所悟入為說正法，於所修行能正教誡。故三神變能攝諸相圓滿教授。
items.en: There is, further, instruction complete in every respect — through three miraculous transformations: the transformation of psychic power, the transformation of mind-reading, and the transformation of admonition. Through the transformation of psychic power, one manifests various miraculous states, causing others to hold one in the deepest reverence — and because of that reverence, they listen to the instruction on yogic mental engagement with the utmost respect. Through the transformation of mind-reading, one is able to discern the particular workings of another's mind. Through the transformation of admonition, one teaches the true dharma exactly suited to the student's faculty, conduct, and degree of realisation, correctly admonishing them in their practice. Thus these three miraculous transformations encompass instruction complete in every respect.

blocks.text: A short day to close fascicle 27: the objects of meditation summarised, and the fourth of the seventeen questions, **instruction** (教授).

"Cessation is of two kinds: the ending of affliction, and the ending of what affliction depends on. The path is of two kinds: the trainee's and the one beyond training's." With this, all four kinds of object (pervasive, purifying, skilful, purifying of affliction) have been explained.

items: **Undistorted**: "expounding the teaching and its meaning without error", "transmitted onward exactly as received, neither adding nor subtracting". Venerable Miào Jìng: you must not mix in your own ideas.

**Gradual**: first the shallow, then the deep. "Teaching the truth of suffering first, before origin, cessation, and path." Venerable Miào Jìng: "later leading them to the deep" means beginning calm and insight.
**Instruction by teaching**: through the scriptures heard.
**Instruction by realisation**: from a teacher's own experience.

blocks.text: Instruction "complete in every respect" uses three miraculous transformations: of **psychic power**, which draws attention; of **mind-reading**, which knows what the student needs; and of **admonition**, which actually teaches. Venerable Miào Jìng: the last is the most important.

The objects of meditation are now complete: from impurity and loving-kindness to the breath, the elements, the aggregates, and the four truths. Fascicle 28 turns to the next questions: training, and the factors that support it.

quiz.q: What are the two kinds of cessation, and how does Venerable Miào Jìng match them to nirvāṇa?
options: ending of affliction and of its basis; the first is nirvāṇa with remainder, the second without
quiz.why: "Cessation is of two kinds: the ending of affliction, and the ending of what affliction depends on." Venerable Miào Jìng: the ending of affliction is nirvāṇa with remainder; the ending of the basis is nirvāṇa without remainder.

quiz.q: The path is of trainees and of those beyond training. Who, according to Venerable Miào Jìng, is on the trainee path?
options: the first, second, third fruits, and those approaching the fourth
quiz.why: "The path is of two kinds: the path of the trainee, and the path of one beyond training." Venerable Miào Jìng: the trainee path is the first, second, and third fruits and those approaching the fourth.

quiz.q: What are the four kinds of instruction, and where, according to Venerable Miào Jìng, does this stand among the seventeen sections?
options: undistorted, gradual, teaching-, and realisation-instruction; the third section, objects, ends here and the fourth, instruction, begins
quiz.why: "There are four kinds of instruction: undistorted instruction, gradual instruction, teaching-instruction, and realisation-instruction." Venerable Miào Jìng: there are seventeen sections in all; the third, "objects," ends here.

quiz.q: To bring the student into insight into the truths, why teach suffering first, according to Venerable Miào Jìng?
options: without suffering, people cannot arouse the wish for release
quiz.why: "Teaching the truth of suffering first, before the truths of origin, cessation, and the path, so as to bring them into direct insight." Venerable Miào Jìng: without suffering, people cannot give rise to the wish for release, so one first teaches them what the truth of suffering is.

quiz.q: Teaching-instruction transmits "neither adding nor subtracting." What does Venerable Miào Jìng stress?
options: teach by the Buddha's true Dharma, without being clever on one's own
quiz.why: "Transmitted onward to others exactly as received, neither adding to it nor subtracting from it." Venerable Miào Jìng: you must teach students according to the true Dharma the Buddha spoke; don't be clever on your own.

quiz.q: Which supernormal powers do the three miraculous transformations correspond to, according to the masters?
options: Miào Jìng: psychic power corresponds to the power of miraculous movement; Cháng Bǎi: admonition belongs to the knowledge ending the taints, found only in arhats and above
quiz.why: "The transformation of psychic power, the transformation of mind-reading, and the transformation of admonition." Venerable Miào Jìng: the psychic-power transformation refers to the power of miraculous movement. Master Cháng Bǎi: the admonition transformation belongs to the knowledge that ends the taints, which only arhats and above possess. Mind-reading corresponds to knowing others' minds.
